name: pi-sandbox
notes: Forked from carderne/pi-sandbox; local fork adds optional pi-tool-display bash rendering decoration with graceful fallback to built-in rendering when pi-tool-display is absent, named sandbox profiles for subagents, the per-session SandboxService profile layer, network.disabled, and protectNonexistentFiles passthrough. v0.6.8 sync adopted upstream's per-session sandbox managers (#84: createSandboxManager per registration instead of the process-wide singleton, manager threaded through initializeSandbox/updateSandboxConfig/createSandboxedBashOps) and hot config updates (#83: updateConfig instead of reset+initialize, preserving in-flight proxy connections); the fork's sandboxManagerFactory seam in src/sandbox-runtime.ts lets tests substitute a stub manager, and fork tests that monkey-patched the old singleton were adapted to the factory. Upstream removed createNetworkAskCallback (stale init-time allowlist could re-allow removed domains); pi-sandbox's interactive promptDomainBlock flow is unaffected. Re-apply the factory seam, tool-display decoration, profile layer, network.disabled, and protectNonexistentFiles on each future sync.
